query:
INSERT INTO mail_report
                   (reporter_id, sender_id, message_id, reported_at, copy_subject, copy_body)
               SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6
               WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM mail_report
                      WHERE reporter_id = $1 AND closed_at IS NULL) < $7
               RETURNING id AS "id!"
